item.title: Iran Has Been Consistent in War. Will It Be Consistent in Peace Talks?
item.summary: While President Trump’s war aims have changed by the moment, Iran has stuck to firm demands. The question is whether it will compromise in peace negotiations.

item.title: In New War With Israel, Hezbollah Defies Notion That It Was Crippled
item.summary: The Iran-backed Lebanese militant group surprised many with the intensity of its attacks on Israel in the current conflict.

item.title: Lebanon: Images of a Nation Uprooted by War
item.summary: A million people in Lebanon have fled their homes as Israel clashes anew with Hezbollah. This is what their lives look now.

item.title: Iran’s South Africa Mission Trolls Trump Amid Hormuz Ceasefire
item.summary: Official social media accounts for Iranian embassies have engaged in information warfare, but the ones in Africa appear to have taken the lead on the attacks.

item.title: World Leaders Push to Save Iran Talks Amid Israel’s Attacks in Lebanon
item.summary: President Trump’s cease-fire with Iran appears at risk as Vice President JD Vance heads to Pakistan for discussions with Iranian officials.

item.title: Iranian Delegation Arrives at Peace Talks, With Vance en Route
item.summary: There was much uncertainty about the durability of the cease-fire and whether the two sides could reach a long-term deal, as Vice President JD Vance traveled to Pakistan for the talks.

item.title: With Iran Setting Limits, Strait of Hormuz Remains Thorny Politically
item.summary: Even after a cease-fire, Iran is keeping a chokehold on traffic, forcing countries to cut deals that could put them at odds with the U.S.

item.title: Iran Looks to Project Unity With Large Delegation to Peace Talks
item.summary: At least 70 people are in the team that is scheduled to negotiate with the American side in Pakistan on Saturday.

item.title: Fallout of War Piles Economic Pain Onto Europe’s Political Stress
item.summary: Europe is finding itself on the outs with Russia, China and the U.S., in what’s amounting to its very own “Mean Girls” moment.

item.title: ‘I’m Fed Up.’ Frustrated With Trump, Starmer Embraces Other Allies.
item.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer of Britain is strengthening ties in Europe and the Middle East as the once-special relationship with America sours.
